price_basis_note: Adopted constant-dollar inputs with a 2026 price basis. Component acquisition prices follow the specified bill of materials.

cashflow_boundary.rental_and_utilization_source: Adopted rental prices and annual utilization for the two commercial scenarios.
cashflow_boundary.maintenance_source: 17.5% of baseline annual revenue: 105 USD and 131.25 USD/year, varied independently of rental price and utilization.
cashflow_boundary.accounting_assumptions: Adopted inputs: 5% real discount, 0.15 USD/kWh and 90% external charging efficiency; discount sensitivity is 0/5/10%.
cashflow_boundary.replacement: Annual maintenance is an aggregate allowance; scheduled replacement expenditure is zero. Lifetime sets the cashflow horizon.
cashflow_boundary.energy: Restore the initial SOC after each completed mission using net battery depletion, which includes utilized PV, body heating, electronics and equipment loads. Grid-export revenue is zero.
cashflow_boundary.service: Rental returns use the unperturbed RHC mission energy and specified rental prices and utilization; mission metrics report the localized thermal-comfort score.

building.notes: Lumped building model with outdoor design temperature -20C and temperature-dependent COP. Wearable operation uses 14h indoor profiles shifted from the 15C waveform. The remaining 10h use 25C with the same 30-person heat gain. Wearable operation is confined to the mission; PV and wearable/charger heat credits are zero. The output is net building electricity. Deployment measurements address long-duration wearer acceptance, moisture and equipment performance.
